# Script introduction

After two external reviews (29 October 2026), the paper has four main figures, each built around one finding; the European case study, the origins of obligacy, the composition of the regions, the ant matrix and the detailed audits move to the Supporting Information. The first main figure is the world map of `s16` (`plot_world_strategies.png`); this notebook combines the outputs of `s05`–`s28` into the other three:

2. **Overlapping climates, different interactions.** Where the climates of the Cape and southern Australia occur; the four strategies of the Cape and southern Australia against the Mediterranean Basin, standardised over the climate strata they share; how the obligate contrast changes with every variant of the comparison; and every pair of biogeographic regions compared in the climates they share, with the pairs of other regions as a reference.
3. **Lineage predicts, climate does not transfer.** Predictions for held-out realms; deviance explained by lineage and by linear and flexible climate models when species, genera, realms and subfamilies are held out; and the spread of obligate and other genera.
4. **What remains.** Environment: geography against climate, soils and fire for held-out subfamilies; effects given region and lineage, with Holm-adjusted p-values; and dry months of the obligate mutualists and facultative species of every mixed genus. Ants: the share of local ant species that belong to the main partner genera, and the dominance of local ant communities, against the obligate share of each region.

Style: the strategy colours of `butterfly_ant_interactions`; larger type than the notebook figures (base 9.5 pt at a printed width of 7.5 in); recessive grids; no lines joining categories; every interval drawn in full. Nothing is recomputed.

A full run takes under a minute.

## Functions

```{r define_helpers}
# Shared theme: larger type for print, recessive grid, left-aligned bold titles
theme_figure <- function(base_size = 9.5) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 0.5),
          plot.title.position = "plot",
          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = base_size - 1),
          axis.title = element_text(colour = "grey20"),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = "grey25"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = base_size - 0.5),
          legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
          legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
}
tags <- plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")")

# A PNG of another notebook as a panel
png_panel <- function(file) {
  wrap_elements(full = grid::rasterGrob(png::readPNG(file), interpolate = TRUE))
}

# Save a figure with ragg
save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)
}
```

# Figure 2: overlapping climates, different interactions

(a) Where the climate strata of the Mediterranean-climate Cape and southern Australia occur (`s16`). (b) Standardised share of each strategy among the classified species of the Cape and southern Australia (filled) and the Mediterranean Basin (open) within the climate strata each pair shares (area weights; each species counted in every shared stratum it was recorded in); 95% intervals from resampling genera. (c) Difference in the obligate share between the regions of each pair under every variant of the comparison: the main analysis; equal stratum weights; each species in its main stratum; each genus weighted once per region and stratum; species-specific evidence only; and (grey) strata half as wide to twice as wide with minimum occupancies of one to ten pixels. (d) Difference in the obligate share between southern Africa or Australia and each other biogeographic region within the climates they share (at least five shared strata); grey band: range of the differences between all pairs of the other regions.

*Inputs:* s16/plot_shared_climates_panel.png; s18/ standardised_shares.csv, standardised_contrasts.csv, sensitivity.csv; s28/shared_climates_specific.csv; s24/all_pairs.csv
*Outputs:* figure_2_shared_climates.png

```{r figure_2}
shares <- fread(file.path(dir_s18, "standardised_shares.csv"))
con <- fread(file.path(dir_s18, "standardised_contrasts.csv"))
sens <- fread(file.path(dir_s18, "sensitivity.csv"))[strata > 0]
spec <- fread(file.path(dir_s28, "shared_climates_specific.csv"))
allp <- fread(file.path(dir_s24, "all_pairs.csv"))
pairs_shown <- c("Cape vs Mediterranean Basin", "Southern Australia vs Mediterranean Basin")
pair_labels <- c(`Cape vs Mediterranean Basin` = "Cape vs Basin",
                 `Southern Australia vs Mediterranean Basin` = "S. Australia vs Basin")
short_region <- c(Cape = "Cape", `Southern Australia` = "S. Australia",
                  `Mediterranean Basin` = "Basin")

# --- b: four strategies in shared strata (filled: first region of the pair; open: second) ---
sb <- shares[version == "all strata of each species" & weights == "area weights" &
               type %in% types & pair %in% pairs_shown]
sb[, first := region == sub(" vs .*$", "", pair)]
strata_n <- unique(sb[, .(pair, strata)])
# Obligate share of each region of a pair (headline of each facet) and the Basin's retention
ob <- shares[version == "all strata of each species" & weights == "area weights" &
               type == "obligate" & pair %in% pairs_shown]
ret <- fread(file.path(dir_s18, "retained.csv"))
facet_lab <- sapply(pairs_shown, function(p) {
  r <- strsplit(p, " vs ")[[1]]
  sprintf("● %1$s  ○ %2$s (%5$d strata)\nObligate: %3$.0f%% vs %4$.0f%%", short_region[[r[1]]],
          short_region[[r[2]]], 100 * ob[pair == p & region == r[1]]$share,
          100 * ob[pair == p & region == r[2]]$share, strata_n[pair == p]$strata)
})
basin_ret <- ret[pair == pairs_shown[1] & region == "Mediterranean Basin"]
sb[, `:=`(pair = factor(facet_lab[pair], facet_lab), type = factor(type, rev(types)),
          first = factor(first, c(TRUE, FALSE)))]
panel_b <- ggplot(sb, aes(100 * share, type, colour = type, shape = first)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 100 * low, xmax = 100 * high), width = 0, linewidth = 0.6,
                orientation = "y", position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, fill = "white", stroke = 0.9, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  facet_wrap(~ pair, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = type_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 21), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = type_labels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Standardised share of classified species (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "Four strategies within the climates each pair shares",
       subtitle = sprintf("95%% intervals from resampling genera. The strata shared with the Cape hold\n%.0f%% of the Basin's Mediterranean-climate pixels and %.0f%% of its classified species",
                          100 * basin_ret$share_pixels, 100 * basin_ret$share_species)) +
  theme_figure() + theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(1.2, "lines"))

# --- c: every variant of the obligate contrast ---
variant_levels <- c("Main analysis", "Equal stratum weights", "Main stratum of each species",
                    "Genera weighted equally", "Species-specific evidence",
                    "Other strata (×0.5–×2, 1–10 pixels)")
named <- rbind(
  con[pair %in% pairs_shown & version == "all strata of each species" &
        weights == "area weights", .(pair, variant = "Main analysis", difference,
                                     difference_low, difference_high)],
  con[pair %in% pairs_shown & version == "all strata of each species" &
        weights == "equal weights", .(pair, variant = "Equal stratum weights", difference,
                                      difference_low, difference_high)],
  con[pair %in% pairs_shown & version == "main stratum of each species" &
        weights == "area weights", .(pair, variant = "Main stratum of each species",
                                     difference, difference_low, difference_high)],
  con[pair %in% pairs_shown & version == "genus-weighted" & weights == "area weights",
      .(pair, variant = "Genera weighted equally", difference, difference_low,
        difference_high)],
  spec[pair %in% pairs_shown & evidence == "specific" &
         design == "Mediterranean-climate regions",
       .(pair, variant = "Species-specific evidence", difference, difference_low,
         difference_high)])
grid_pts <- sens[pair %in% pairs_shown & !(width_factor == 1 & min_pixels == 5),
                 .(pair, variant = "Other strata (×0.5–×2, 1–10 pixels)", difference)]
named[, `:=`(pair = factor(pair_labels[pair], pair_labels),
             variant = factor(variant, rev(variant_levels)))]
grid_pts[, `:=`(pair = factor(pair_labels[pair], pair_labels),
                variant = factor(variant, rev(variant_levels)))]
panel_c <- ggplot(named, aes(100 * difference, variant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 100 * difference_low, xmax = 100 * difference_high), width = 0,
                linewidth = 0.55, orientation = "y", colour = "#E69F00") +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, colour = "#E69F00") +
  geom_point(data = grid_pts, size = 1.4, colour = "grey45", alpha = 0.7,
             position = position_jitter(height = 0.12, width = 0, seed = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ pair, ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Difference in obligate share (points)", y = NULL,
       title = "Every variant of the comparison") +
  theme_figure()

# --- d: southern regions against every other region in shared climates ---
pd <- allp[strata >= 5]
ctrl <- pd[group == "Control pairs"]
pd <- pd[group != "Control pairs"]
pd[, `:=`(south = factor(paste(region_1, "vs"), c("Southern Africa vs", "Australia vs")),
          other = factor(region_short[region_2], rev(region_short[region_levels])))]
band <- data.table(xmin = 100 * min(ctrl$difference), xmax = 100 * max(ctrl$difference))
panel_d <- ggplot(pd, aes(100 * difference, other)) +
  geom_rect(data = band, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey88") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 100 * difference_low, xmax = 100 * difference_high), width = 0,
                linewidth = 0.55, orientation = "y", colour = "#3B3B3B") +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, colour = "#3B3B3B") +
  facet_wrap(~ south, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Difference in obligate share (points)", y = NULL,
       title = "Every region in the climates it shares",
       subtitle = sprintf("Grey: range of the %d pairs of other regions", nrow(ctrl))) +
  theme_figure()

fig <- png_panel(file.path(dir_s16, "plot_shared_climates_panel.png")) / panel_b /
  (panel_c | panel_d) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.72, 0.62, 1)) + tags
save_figure(fig, "figure_2_shared_climates", 7.5, 10)
fig
```

# Figure 3: lineage predicts, climate does not transfer

(a) Obligate share among the associated species of each realm (black bar) and as predicted by models fitted to the other seven realms (points, with 95% intervals from resampling genera within the realm). (b) Hexagons of about 210,000 km² holding the records of each obligate genus (at least half of its classified species obligate) and other genus, adjusted to the mean stem age and number of recorded species (points: genera; black: the model's predicted hexagons with 95% intervals; `s33`). (c) Deviance explained for the obligacy of associated species by lineage (random intercepts of subfamily and genus; an unseen genus or subfamily is averaged over the distribution of lineages), by climate (six predictors, linear or, for held-out subfamilies, also as smooth terms with a temperature–aridity interaction) and by latitude and hemisphere: for species held out (their congeners stay in the training data), whole genera held out, whole realms held out, split into the species whose genus also occurs in another realm and those whose genus occurs only in the held-out realm, and whole subfamilies held out. Species and genera: median and range of three repeats of ten folds; realms and subfamilies: all held-out species pooled, relative to the training share, with 95% intervals from resampling genera.

*Inputs:* s20/ held_out_metrics.csv, held_out_pooled.csv, held_out_by_genus.csv; s12/lineage_out_of_sample.csv; s28/flexible_climate.csv; s33/confinement_genera.csv
*Outputs:* figure_3_lineage_climate.png

```{r figure_3}
met <- fread(file.path(dir_s20, "held_out_metrics.csv"))
pooled <- fread(file.path(dir_s20, "held_out_pooled.csv"))
oos <- fread(file.path(dir_s12, "lineage_out_of_sample.csv"))
flex <- fread(file.path(dir_s28, "flexible_climate.csv"))
gs <- fread(file.path(dir_s23, "genus_spread.csv"))
spread <- fread(file.path(dir_s23, "spread_models.csv"))

# --- a: held-out realms, obligacy ---
show <- c("climate", "latitude x hemisphere", "lineage")
mc <- met[contrast == "obligate" & scheme == "held-out realm" & model %in% show]
mc[, `:=`(unit = factor(region_short[unit], rev(region_short[region_levels])),
          model = factor(model, rev(show)))]
obs <- unique(mc[, .(unit, observed, events, species)])
panel_a <- ggplot(mc, aes(y = unit)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 100 * predicted_low, xmax = 100 * predicted_high, colour = model),
                width = 0, linewidth = 0.55, orientation = "y",
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = 100 * predicted, colour = model), size = 2,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = 100 * observed), shape = 124, size = 6, colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours, labels = model_labels[show], breaks = show,
                      name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Obligate share of associated species (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "Each realm predicted from the other seven",
       subtitle = "Black bar: observed") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_figure()

# --- b: deviance explained, obligacy: held-out species and genera, held-out realms split into
# species of genera known from other realms and of genera found only in the held-out realm, and
# held-out subfamilies ---
scheme_levels <- c("Species\nheld out", "Genera\nheld out", "Realms held out:\ngenus known",
                   "Realms held out:\ngenus new", "Subfamilies\nheld out")
o <- oos[contrast == "obligate" & evidence == "all" & model %in% c("lineage", "climate") &
           scheme != "in sample",
         .(d2 = median(d2), low = min(d2), high = max(d2)), by = .(scheme, model)]
o[, scheme := c(`species held out` = scheme_levels[1],
                `genera held out` = scheme_levels[2])[scheme]]
bg <- fread(file.path(dir_s20, "held_out_by_genus.csv"))[
  contrast == "obligate" & model %in% c("climate", "latitude x hemisphere", "lineage"),
  .(scheme = c(`genus known` = scheme_levels[3], `genus unseen` = scheme_levels[4])[genus_group],
    model, d2, low = d2_low, high = d2_high)]
p20 <- pooled[contrast == "obligate" & scheme == "held-out subfamily" &
                model %in% c("climate", "latitude x hemisphere", "lineage"),
              .(scheme = scheme_levels[5], model, d2, low = d2_low, high = d2_high)]
p28 <- flex[contrast == "obligate" & evidence == "all" & model == "climate (flexible)" &
              scheme == "held-out subfamily",
            .(scheme = scheme_levels[5], model, d2, low = d2_low, high = d2_high)]
perf <- rbind(o, bg, p20, p28)
model_order <- c("lineage", "climate", "climate (flexible)", "latitude x hemisphere")
perf[, `:=`(scheme = factor(scheme, scheme_levels), model = factor(model, rev(model_order)))]
panel_b <- ggplot(perf, aes(100 * d2, model, colour = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 100 * low, xmax = 100 * high), width = 0, linewidth = 0.55,
                orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ scheme, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = model_labels) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-20, 80)) +
  labs(x = "Deviance explained for obligacy (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "Lineage predicts while the genus is known; the climate models tested perform poorly") +
  theme_figure() + theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(0.9, "lines"))

# --- c: spread of obligate and other genera, adjusted for stem age and recorded species: each
# genus's log hexagons at the mean log age and log species (partial residuals), and the model's
# predicted hexagons for the two groups with 95% intervals ---
cg <- fread(file.path(dir_s33, "confinement_genera.csv"))
m <- lm(log(hexagons) ~ obligate + log_age + log_species, data = cg)
b <- coef(m)
cg[, adjusted := exp(log(hexagons) - b[["log_age"]] * (log_age - mean(log_age)) -
                       b[["log_species"]] * (log_species - mean(log_species)))]
nd <- data.table(obligate = c(0, 1), log_age = mean(cg$log_age), log_species = mean(cg$log_species))
pr <- predict(m, newdata = nd, se.fit = TRUE)
nd[, `:=`(fit = exp(pr$fit), low = exp(pr$fit - 1.96 * pr$se.fit), high = exp(pr$fit + 1.96 * pr$se.fit))]
grp <- c(`0` = "Other genera", `1` = "Obligate genera")
cg[, group := factor(grp[as.character(obligate)], grp)]
nd[, group := factor(grp[as.character(obligate)], grp)]
panel_c <- ggplot(cg, aes(group, adjusted, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.45, position = position_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_errorbar(data = nd, aes(y = fit, ymin = low, ymax = high), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.8,
                colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = nd, aes(y = fit), size = 3, colour = "black") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Other genera` = "#9A9A9A", `Obligate genera` = "#E69F00"),
                      guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Hexagons with records\n(at mean stem age and species)",
       title = "Obligate genera occupy fewer places",
       subtitle = sprintf("%.1f times fewer, given stem age and recorded\nspecies (%d and %d genera)",
                          exp(-b[["obligate"]]), sum(cg$obligate == 1), sum(cg$obligate == 0))) +
  theme_figure() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))

fig <- (panel_a | panel_c) / panel_b + plot_layout(heights = c(1.25, 0.8)) + tags
save_figure(fig, "figure_3_lineage_climate", 7.5, 7.6)
fig
```

# Figure 4: what remains

(a) Deviance explained when the obligacy of each subfamily is predicted by a logistic regression fitted to the other subfamilies: geography (latitude by hemisphere, dashed line; region), geography with one property added, and each property alone. (b) For every origin of obligate mutualism, the difference between its mutualists and their facultative relatives in the longest run of months with less than 50 mm of rain at their occupied pixels (in SD units; species weighted equally, 95% intervals from the species), unmatched, compared within 1 °C temperature bins, and within temperature bins and biomes (`s41`); diamonds: random-effects estimates over origins. (c) The same pooled estimates for annual mean temperature (H1, compared within bins of dry-season length), the run of months below 50 mm (H2) and the climatic water deficit (H3).

*Inputs:* s06/stability_cv.csv; s08/drivers_cv.csv; s41/ case_origins.csv, case_summary.csv
*Outputs:* figure_4_remaining_signal.png

```{r figure_4}
scv <- fread(file.path(dir_s06, "stability_cv.csv"))[scheme == "subfamily"]
dcv <- fread(file.path(dir_s08, "drivers_cv.csv"))[scheme == "subfamily"]
holm <- fread(file.path(dir_s19, "holm_obligacy.csv"))
label_of <- function(v) ifelse(v %in% names(property_labels), property_labels[v], v)

# --- a: held-out subfamilies ---
cv <- rbind(
  scv[set == "region", .(label = "Region", group = "Geography", d2 = median(cv_d2))],
  scv[set == "latitude x hemisphere", .(label = "Latitude × hemisphere", group = "Geography",
                                        d2 = median(cv_d2))],
  scv[set == "latitude x hemisphere + anomaly",
      .(label = "+ LGM temperature anomaly", group = "Geography +\none property",
        d2 = median(cv_d2))],
  dcv[grepl("^reference [+] ", set) & set != "reference + all drivers",
      .(label = paste("+", label_of(sub("^reference [+] ", "", set))),
        group = "Geography +\none property", d2 = median(cv_d2)), by = set][, set := NULL],
  scv[set == "anomaly", .(label = "LGM temperature anomaly", group = "Property\nalone",
                          d2 = median(cv_d2))],
  dcv[grepl(" alone$", set) & set != "all drivers alone",
      .(label = label_of(sub(" alone$", "", set)), group = "Property\nalone",
        d2 = median(cv_d2)), by = set][, set := NULL])
cv[, group := factor(group, c("Geography", "Geography +\none property", "Property\nalone"))]
cv[, key := factor(paste(group, label), paste(group, label)[order(group, d2)])]
ref <- cv[label == "Latitude × hemisphere"]$d2
panel_a <- ggplot(cv, aes(100 * d2, key, colour = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 100 * ref, colour = "#009E73", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = setNames(as.character(cv$label), as.character(cv$key))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Geography = "#009E73", `Geography +\none property` = "#7F7F7F",
                                 `Property\nalone` = "#B73779"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Deviance explained in held-out subfamilies (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "Geography predicts obligacy in unseen lineages") +
  theme_figure() + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0))

# --- b: the dry-season contrast at matched conditions (s41): for every origin of obligate
# mutualism, mutualists minus facultative relatives in the run of months below 50 mm, unmatched,
# at matched temperature, and at matched temperature and biome; and the pooled estimate ---
case_settings <- c(`Unmatched (no bins)` = "Unmatched",
                   `Primary: origin contrasts, cleaned records, 1-unit bins` = "Same temperature",
                   `Matched on bin and biome` = "Same temperature and biome")
co <- fread(file.path(dir_s41, "case_origins.csv"))[hypothesis == "H2" & setting %in% names(case_settings)]
cs <- fread(file.path(dir_s41, "case_summary.csv"))[setting %in% names(case_settings)]
short_origin <- function(x) vapply(strsplit(x, " + ", fixed = TRUE), function(g)
  if (length(g) > 2) paste0(g[1], " + ", length(g) - 1, " genera") else paste(g, collapse = " + "), character(1))
# Each origin labelled with its species in the primary setting (matching can drop species)
lab <- co[setting == names(case_settings)[2], .(origin, row = sprintf("%s (%d/%d)", short_origin(origin), mutualists, facultative))]
co <- merge(co, lab, by = "origin")
ord <- co[setting == names(case_settings)[2]][order(difference)]$row
cb <- rbind(co[, .(setting, row, difference, low = difference - 1.96 * se, high = difference + 1.96 * se, pooled = FALSE)],
            cs[hypothesis == "H2", .(setting, row = "All origins", difference = pooled, low = pooled_low,
                                     high = pooled_high, pooled = TRUE)])
cb[, `:=`(row = factor(row, c("All origins", ord)), setting = factor(case_settings[setting], case_settings))]
match_colours <- c(Unmatched = "#9A9A9A", `Same temperature` = "#E69F00", `Same temperature and biome` = "#3B3B3B")
panel_b <- ggplot(cb, aes(difference, row, colour = setting)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = low, xmax = high), width = 0, linewidth = 0.5, orientation = "y",
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.65)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = pooled), size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.65)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 18), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = match_colours, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Mutualists minus facultative relatives:\nrun of months below 50 mm (SD)", y = NULL,
       title = "Dry seasons, origin by origin",
       subtitle = "In brackets: mutualist/facultative species") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 3)) +
  theme_figure() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))

# --- c: the three climatic hypotheses, pooled over origins, at each level of matching ---
hyp_labels <- c(H1 = "H1 warmth", H2 = "H2 dry-season length", H3 = "H3 water stress")
cc <- cs[, .(hypothesis = factor(hyp_labels[hypothesis], rev(hyp_labels)), setting = factor(case_settings[setting], case_settings),
             pooled, pooled_low, pooled_high, positive, origins)]
panel_c <- ggplot(cc, aes(pooled, hypothesis, colour = setting)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = pooled_low, xmax = pooled_high), width = 0, linewidth = 0.5, orientation = "y",
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, shape = 18, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = match_colours, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Pooled over origins (SD, 95% CI)", y = NULL, title = "Warmth, dry-season length, water stress",
       subtitle = "H1 compared at the same dry-season length") +
  theme_figure()

fig <- panel_a | (panel_b / panel_c + plot_layout(heights = c(2.2, 1)))
fig <- fig + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.15)) + tags
save_figure(fig, "figure_4_remaining_signal", 9, 7.5)
fig
```
